snippet.title: Sushi Cat - tower defense
snippet.description:
Wish List : https://armor.ag/SC-TD

Sushi Cat is BACK and needs your help! Build quirky towers, chomp endless waves of corrupt sushi, and stop the evil Broccolinni’s buffet of destruction! 

Featuring purr-fectly silly towers like the Wasabi Flamethrower, Chopstick Sniper, and Meowrtar; only YOU can keep Sushi Cat fed and the world safe.

Sushi Cat Tower Defense — Coming soon to PC and Nintendo Switch!
Steam - https://armor.ag/SC-TD
Switch - Coming Soon!
